title: Profile and preferences
description: These choices decide what goes into your reports and which ideas are generated for you. Sources and collection belong to the instance and apply to everyone.

interests.title: Interests
interests.hint: They rank what is relevant to you. Write the way you would say it: “developer tools”, “fintech in Brazil”.
interests.label: Add interest
interests.notRanked: No embedding model is configured on this instance, so reports rank items by recency and engagement. Interests will count once an admin configures one.

report.title: Daily report
report.hint: Covers the last 24 h and is ready at the chosen time.
report.outputLangHint: Sources can be in any language; reports and ideas come out in this one.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.hint: Generated after the daily report. Repeated ideas become new versions, so the number may vary.

models.title: Models
models.hint: Pick among the models enabled by the admin and those of your own providers. A local model has no per-use cost; a larger model usually writes better ideas.

ownProviders.title: My AI providers
ownProviders.hint: Use your own API key. Reports and ideas can then use these models: pick them in “Models” above. The key is encrypted and never shown again, and the costs go to your account at the provider.

card.noModels: No models registered yet. Test the connection and add the ones you want to use.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.body: Paste your {{name}} API key. We test the connection and list the models you can use.
connect.doneBody: Add the chat models you want to use. You can change this later.

form.apiKeyHint: Encrypted on the server and never shown again. Usage is billed to your {{name}} account.

replace.title: Replace {{name}} key
replace.body: The new key replaces the current one. Your registered models are kept.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: The key and the registered models are deleted. Preferences using these models go back to the instance default.

test.noDetail: The provider gave no further details.
test.noModels: The provider answered but lists no models.

found.hint: Add the chat models you want to use. Embedding models are not offered.

models.removeBody: Preferences using this model go back to the instance default.

errors.BYOK_DISABLED: The admin turned off personal AI providers on this instance.
errors.PROVIDER_KIND_TAKEN: You already have a provider of this type.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: Provider not found. Reload the page.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: Model not found. Reload the page.

sources.title: Sources
sources.hint: Which instance sources go into your analyses.
sources.empty: The instance has no sources yet. Ask an admin to add some.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Applies only to you, on this and your other devices.

security.title: Security
security.hint: Changing the password ends the sessions on your other devices.
